ns2:section.sectionText: Undergraduates may wish to consider Math 257, Linear Algebra with Computational Applications, for a more applied treatment of this material. Check with your advisor to see whether Math 257 can be used to fill degree requirements. (Math 257 will count for the Math minor.) Students in MATH 415 are expected to have prior credit for Math 241. ECE undergrads for whom this course is appropriate should email ece-advisor@illinois.edu with UIN to request a major override.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering major(s).
